Plant 42 and the flight-test ranges: SNT-TC-1A versus NAS 410 for Antelope Valley NDT careers

Palmdale's aerospace work is mostly defense production and flight test. Northrop Grumman builds the B-21 Raider at Air Force Plant 42, where Lockheed Martin's Skunk Works also operates. Out past Lancaster, test aircraft fly from Edwards and from NASA's Armstrong center on the same desert, and farther into Kern County the Mojave airport hosts flight-test and space-hardware firms. Machine shops, composite fabricators and tooling builders across the valley feed the primes, and each of those employers answers the certification question in its own way.

Why defense production points toward NAS 410

NAS 410 took over from MIL-STD-410 on defense contracts in 1998, and it commonly reaches Antelope Valley suppliers the same way today: through the quality clauses of a prime's purchase order. When a clause invokes it, its minimums for training, experience, examinations and vision become contractual, the shop designates a Responsible Level 3 (RL3) in writing, and the prime's auditors and Nadcap AC7114 auditors check the personnel files against it. A composite or machining supplier in Lancaster can be pulled into a NAS 410 program by a single order. Classified programs add their own entry rules: citizenship and clearance govern access to the building, not NDT certification, and neither replaces the other.

Flight-test hangars run on different paperwork

Military test aircraft at Edwards are maintained under the service's own directives, technical orders and the operator's program, and the people doing that work are qualified within those systems. Civilian contractors supporting test programs follow whatever their contract requires, and Mojave's flight-test and space firms set requirements in their own quality systems. If you move between a hangar and a production supplier, plan on being examined and certified again; only your records come with you. Ask a test-program employer early which document its personnel file is audited against, because the answer shapes what you should log from your first week.

A composite UT technician's route through the valley

Picture a technician hired by a Palmdale composite shop under an SNT-TC-1A-based written practice, scanning laminates for disbonds and porosity. A year later a new customer order invokes NAS 410. The RL3 reviews the file, credits the documented UT training and logged hours that fit the new written practice, sets gap training where the formal records fall short, and arranges general, specific and practical examinations under NAS 410. The old certification does not convert; it supplies evidence. When the same technician adds penetrant, NAS 410's appetite for formal surface-method training, larger than SNT-TC-1A's recommendation, becomes the next hurdle. The aviation ultrasonic testing guide covers composite inspection in more depth.

For valley suppliers building or repairing a program

  • Write the governing standard and revision on every certification; NAS 410 Revision 6 was released in December 2025.
  • Keep training evidence to NAS 410's level from day one: approved outlines, qualified instructors, recorded hours.
  • Make the RL3 designation explicit and in writing, and list which outside agencies the written practice allows.
  • If an outside agency delivers any training or examinations, name it in the written practice; under NAS 410 the RL3 controls that agency's work and the employer stays responsible.
  • Rehearse an AC7114 trace: pick a signed report and follow it back to training, experience, examinations and vision.

Atlantis prepares and reviews the NAS 410 audit documentation behind that trace for your RL3 to approve, and the aerospace written practice page covers programs built on SNT-TC-1A.

Atlantis and Antelope Valley employers

The Atlantis offer for aerospace here is ASNT NDT Level III consulting, SNT-TC-1A-based training and UT, MT, PT and VT inspection, the same as for any other sector. Technicians study theory self-paced online, put questions to an ASNT NDT Level III, rehearse in the Practical NDT simulator, and take the hands-on practical at the employer's plant or hangar. There is no Atlantis classroom anywhere in the Antelope Valley. Atlantis does not provide NAS 410 training, certification, examinations or a Responsible Level 3 to Palmdale or Lancaster employers. Whether any outside course will count toward a NAS 410 certification is for the employer's RL3 to settle before anyone enrolls. The NAS 410 vs SNT-TC-1A guide and NAS 410 explained go into the detail.
